case_title: Postman Vengaisamy & Ors. v. State Represented by Inspector of Police
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.149; IPC s.148; IPC s.506 (Part II); IPC s.324; IPC s.342
aggravating_circumstances: History of previous attack on the deceased, formation of unlawful assembly with a common object to commit culpable homicide
high_court_outcome: Confirmed the order of conviction and sentence
neutral_facts: The accused, who were strangers to the victim, formed an unlawful assembly with the intent to take the life of the victim. On the fateful day, the accused surrounded the victim and his son, along with another individual, and attacked them with weapons. The victim sustained multiple injuries and eventually succumbed to his wounds. The accused also injured the son and the other individual. The prosecution presented evidence including eyewitness accounts and medical reports that corroborated the injuries sustained by the victim and the other individuals. The trial court and High Court convicted the accused for various offences, including murder, based on the evidence provided.
